verdict.rationale: A web framework could plausibly have an official hosting/deploy platform with a public status page, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows `ng deploy`, a CLI command that invokes a deploy builder. Nothing shows an official Angular hosting platform, a public status page, or an incident history.

support.subject: As a developer, I can check a public status page and incident history for the framework's official hosting/deploy platform before relying on it in production
